title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1984-05-07
lineage: Maxell XLII > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged.
source: Sennheiser 441's > patched thru unknown decks > Toshiba KTR2 Walkman. Recorded in the mezzanine. 1st Gen cassette transferred.

ai_review.summary: A mixed‑quality matrix recording with a decent crowd‑band blend but lacking crispness; no specific musical highlights are mentioned.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers disagree sharply – one rates the tape a single star, saying it "does not sound so hot," while the other gives four stars praising the balance of crowd and band despite noting that the audio is "just not crisp." No comments were made about the performance itself, leaving the musical quality undefined.

ai_rating.rationale: One very negative review (1★) focuses on poor sound, while another is more positive (4★) but mentions lack of crispness; with only two conflicting reviews the overall rating settles near the low‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Blend of crowd and band noted; audio is not crisp and some listeners find it lacking in clarity.
